RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday, the August 17, 2006/Sravana 26, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Prime Minister; Atomic Energy; Coal; Communications and
Information Technology; External Affairs; Housing and Urban Poverty
Alleviation;  Information and Broadcasting; Overseas Indian Affairs;
Panchayati Raj; Parliamentary Affairs; Personnel, Public
Grievances and Pensions; Planning; Shipping, Road
Transport and Highways; Space; Statistics and
Programme Implementation; Urban
Development; Youth Affairs
and Sports)
Total number of questions — 20
Neglect of MPLAD projects by
district administration
*301. DR. K. MALAISAMY: Will the
Minister of STATISTICS AND
PROGRAMME IMPLEMENTATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the district
administration, the implementing agency
of MPLADS, is not invoking enough
interest as done for other works;
(b) whether it is more so in the case of
MPLADS initiated by certain MPs
opposing the ruling Government either at
the State or the Centre;
(c) the guidelines/standing instructions
to the district administration/implementing
agency for MPLADS while inaugurating
or completing the work and the place of
concerned MP for such occasions;
(d) whether there have been instances
of total neglect and indifference on part of
the district administration; and
(e) if so, the devices to correct such
violations of guidelines and the action
against lapses?
Poverty alleviation schemes
*302. SHRI O.T. LEPCHA: Will the
Minister of HOUSING AND URBAN
POVERTY ALLEVIATION be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of the poverty alleviation
programmes that have been formulated and
are being implemented in different parts
of the country, schemes-wise, State-wise;
(b) the total funds allocated, released
and utilized by Government during the last
two years for implementation of the above
schemes, State-wise; and
(c) the number of persons benefited
from these schemes?

94
Opening of Suchetgarh-Sialkot border
*303. SHRI T.S. BAJWA: Will the
PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have again
taken up the matter of opening of
Suchetgarh-Sialkot border in Jammu and
Kashmir with the Government of Pakistan;
and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Rajasthan Atomic Power Station at
Rawathbhata
*304. SHRI MAHENDRA MOHAN:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Unit-I of
Rajasthan Atomic Power Station,
Rawatbhata, has stopped generation since
October, 2004;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) by when it is likely to recommence
generation;
(d) if not, the steps being taken by
Government to compensate Rajasthan for
loss of generation due to permanent outage
of RAPS Unit-I;
(e) whether Government of Rajasthan
has requested to enhance its allocation from
RAPS Units (existing as well as new units);
(f) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(g) the steps being taken by Government
for considering the request of Rajasthan?
Rail-road linkage projects for minor
ports of Gujarat
*305. SHRI KANJIBHAI PATEL:
SHRI SURYAKANT BHAI
ACHARYA:
Will the Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a number of
rail-road linkage projects pertaining to the
minor ports of Gujarat received from the
concerned Government are pending and
require the preparation and execution of
an urgent and early implementation plan
by the Central Government;
(b) if so, the details of such projects;
(c) the progress made in respect of these
projects during the last three years,
year-wise and project-wise; and
(d) the steps proposed to be taken
during the current year, along with the
project-wise details thereof?
Use of electronic media for social
change and empowerment
*306. SHRI VIJAYKUMAR
RUPANI: Will the PRIME MINISTER be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Planning Commission has
convened a meeting on 7th April, 2006;
(b) whether it is also a fact that a
decision was taken to initiate a programme
on the "use of electronic media for social
change and empowerment in the State of
Gujarat" through Doordarshan;
(c) the necessity for this project;
(d) the reasons why only Gujarat was
selected for this programme;
(e) whether the producer for the said pilot
project was also decided in the said meeting;
(f) whether the Planning Commission
were aware that the selected producer is
facing criminal proceedings; and
(g) if so, the status of these cases?

95
Death of Indians in Bahrain
†*307. SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELWAL: Will the Minister of
OVERSEAS INDIAN AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that death of 16
Indians in Bahrain has shown
Government's indifferent attitude towards
Indian workers working abroad;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the
job of Overseas Indian Ministry is
restricted only to overseas Indian
industrialists and conferences of
prominent persons;
(c) if not, the details of the efforts
being made by Government for the
welfare of Indian workers working abroad;
and
(d) the details of the efforts made for
the welfare of overseas workers by
Government, with achievements, during
the last three years?
Four-laning of National Highways
*308. SHRI RAMDAS AGARWAL:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of SHIPPING,
ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that
Government of Rajasthan has proposed
for four-laning of NH-11 (Jaipur-
Reengus-Sikar road section), NH-12
(Jaipur-Tonk-Kota-Jhalawar road section
up to MP Border) and NH-14 (Beawar-
Pali-Sirohi road section) and NH-8
(Beawar-Udaipur section);
(b) if so, by when these National
Highways will be four lanned;
(c) whether it is a fact that the stretch
between in Chittorgarh to Neemuch of
NH-79 qualifies for four laning; and
(d) if so, by when this stretch between
Chittorgarh to Neemuch would be four
lanned?
Sports bodies headed by non-
professionals
*309. DR. NARAYAN SINGH
MANAKLAO: Will the Minister of
YOUTH AFFAIRS AND SPORTS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that majority of
the sports bodies in India are being
headed by non-professionals and non-
sportspersons;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) the current practice in other sporting
nations such as China, USA and Russia;
(d) whether Government intend to
change the leadership of sports bodies to
bring professionalism in sports; and
(e) if so, by when?
Metro train services at night
*310. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
SHRI AMAR SINGH:
Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the total number of Metro trains
operating in the capital at present and the
average number of passengers traveling
daily in those trains; and
(b) whether Government propose to
direct the Metro Corporation to operate
night services also and if so, by when and
if not, the reasons therefor?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

96
Funds allocated for e-governance
*311. SHRI S.P.M. SYED KHAN:
Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that even though
the country has achieved tremendous
progress and development in
communication and information
technology, the implementation of e-
governance at grass-root level still remains
a matter of promise and yet to come true;
(b) whether Government have held any
concrete consultation with the State
Governments to implement e-governance
as mandatory;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the amount allocated especially for
e-governance by Government during the
last five years?
Development/maintenance of
NHs in Rajasthan
*312. DR. GYAN PRAKASH
PILANIA: Will the Minister of
SHIPPING, ROAD TRANSPORT AND
HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) the amount allocated, released and
spent for the development and
maintenance of National Highways in
Rajasthan, year-wise;
(b) the achievement made so far;
(c) whether the State has sent requisite
utilization certificate to the Central
Government;
(d) whether the investment is not
paltry, Rajasthan being largest State of
the country;
(e) whether a number of proposals of
the Rajasthan Government requesting for
Central assistance for strengthening and
widening of National Highways/State
Highways are pending for clearance;
(f) if so, the details thereof;
(g) the reasons therefor; and
(h) the steps taken/proposed by
Government in this regard?
India's bid for 2014 Asian Games
*313. SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA: Will
the Minister of YOUTH AFFAIRS AND
SPORTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India has
made a bid to host 2014 Asian Games in
the country;
(b) if so, whether Government have
decided upon the city or place which
would host the games if the bid is
selected;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the details of any other preparation
underway to make the Indian hosting of
2014 Asian Games a success?
India's position in IT at world level
*314. SHRI N.R. GOVINDARAJAR:
Will the Minister of COMMUNICA-
TIONS AND INFORMATION
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India has
out-stripped China and Russia in IT race
as per Global Information Technology
Report;
(b) if so, the details thereof and India's
place in the IT sector as per this report;
and
(c) the steps taken/proposed to be
taken for improving India's place in IT
sector at international level?

97
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Delhi Golf Club
*315. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have acquired
the right to nominate eminent persons in
various institutions like the Delhi Golf
Club;
(b) if so, whether only eminent persons
are to be nominated to Delhi Golf Club,
etc.;
(c) the details of people nominated to
Delhi Golf Club in the years 2003-04,
2004-05 and 2005-06 by Government;
(d) whether it is a fact that this scheme
has hurt genuine people and those who are
really qualified; and
(e) the proposal to revoke such
nominations?
Simplification of immigration process
*316. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of OVERSEAS INDIAN
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there have
been large number of complaints about the
processes and poor co-ordination among
eight Protectorate of Emigrants Offices in
the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the details of steps taken or proposed
to be taken for simplifying the immigration
process, by making it transparent, so that
increasing number of Indian workers
travelling abroad would be benefited?
Shortage of postal staff
*317. SHRI MATILAL SARKAR:
Will the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) the number of vacant posts in the
Postal Department, category-wise;
(b) whether Government are aware that
the ordinary postal delivery has become
irregular due to shortage of staff; and
(c) the steps to be taken to fill the vacant
posts?
Report of National Knowledge
Commission
*318. DR. VIJAY MALLYA:
SHRI LALIT SURI:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether National Knowledge
Commission headed by Sam Pitroda has
submitted its report on e-governance and
other education related issues to
Government;
(b) if so, the important recommenda-
tions of the Commission;
(c) whether Government propose to set
up a high level committee to implement
these recommendations; and
(d) the budget allocation made for
the implementation of proposed
recommendations?
Functioning of DDA
†*319. SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARWAL: Will the Minister of
URBAN DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Delhi Development
Authority is busy mainly in selling land,
collecting money and construction of flats
only;

98
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Central Government
have taken any steps or propose to take
steps to bring changes in the said
functioning of the Delhi Development
Authority; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Service centres in Kerala
*320. SHRI P.R. RAJAN: Will the
Minister of COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal to set
up many service centres in the rural areas
of the country under the National
e-governance plan;
(b) if so, the details thereof including
the number of above centres to be set up
State-wise, category-wise;
(c) if so, whether any proposal has been
submitted by the Competent Authority
of Kerala for capacity building for
e-governance implementation in Kerala;
and
(d) if so, the status of the above proposal
in detail?

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday, the August 17, 2006/Sravana 26, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Prime Minister; Atomic Energy; Coal; Communications and
 Information Technology; External Affairs; Housing and Urban Poverty
Alleviation; Information and Broadcasting; Overseas Indian Affairs;
Panchayati Raj; Parliamentary Affairs; Personnel, Public
Grievances and Pensions; Planning; Shipping, Road
Transport and Highways; Space; Statistics and
Programme Implementation; Urban
Development; Youth Affairs
and Sports)
Total number of questions — 155
Irradiation technology for food
preservation
2104. SHRI BALAVANT ALIAS
BAL APTE:
SHRI VINAY KATIYAR:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have
formulated any strategy for use of
irradiation technology for food
preservation;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have
conducted any research to ascertain the
utility to be derived from irradiation in the
field of food preservation;
(d) if so, the results thereof; and
(e) the steps taken to augment the use
of this facility in the country?
Setting up of new nuclear plants in
Andhra Pradesh
2105. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Site
Selection Committee appointed by the
Department in September, 2005, selected
some sites in Andhra Pradesh to set up
nuclear power plants;
(b) if so, the details of sites identified
by the Site Selection Committee;
(c) whether the assessment of the sites
offered by the State of Andhra Pradesh has
been done by the Site Selection Committee;
and
(d) the rehabilitation package, in the case
of selection of the site, that Government
provide to the affected people?

485
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Thorium reserves
2106. SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS:
SHRI PENUMALLI MADHU:
SHRI BALAVANT ALIAS BAL
APTE:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) the total estimated quantity of
thorium reserves available in our country;
(b) the names of the Indian States where
such reserves are located;
(c) whether India has any plan to
generate power using thorium instead of
uranium;
(d) if so, its details thereof and the target
of nuclear power generation achieved during
the year 2005-06; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Partnership with foreign and private
companies to increase coal production
†2107. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that foreign
companies have become a necessity in
order to increase coal production in the
country now;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the reasons for which Government
are not taking the decision for entering into
partnership with private sector to increase
production in this sector; and
(d) the names of the countries with
whose companies talks on bilateral basis
have already begun?
Pending projects with CIL
2108. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of the projects completed/
lying pending with Coal India Limited and
each of its subsidiaries during the current
year;
(b) the details of the estimated and
projected expenditure of pending and
completed projects;
(c) whether projects of Coal India
Limited and its subsidiaries are lying
pending for the last ten years; and
(d) if so, the reasons therefor and the
details thereof?
Regulatory Commission on coal
†2109. SHRI LAXMINARAYAN
SHARMA: Will the Minister of COAL be
pleased to state by when action would be
taken to constitute a Regulatory
Commission for the proper control on the
rates and quality of supply of coal?
Criteria for allotting captive coal
mines
2110. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY :
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Central Government
propose to change the criteria for allotting
captive coal mines;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the priority to be given to sectors in
the changed criteria?

486
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Captive coal mining blocks
2111. SHRI SURENDRA LATH:
MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased
to state:
(a) the criteria fixed for allotment of coal
blocks;
(b) the number of coal/mining leases that
have been allotted for captive mining;
(c) the number out of these that are in
operation; and
(d) the total production of coal from
different captive mines allotted in last three
years?
Profit earned by MTNL
†2112. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that under mobile
phone services, the clientele of MTNL is
on the increase;
(b) if so, the clientele as it was at the
end of March, 2004, March, 2005 and
March, 2006 respectively;
(c) the number of subscribers under the
fixed line services during the said period
respectively; and
(d) the amount of profits accrued to the
corporation at the end of each year during
the said period?
VPTs in Orissa
2113. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of COMMUNICA-
TIONS AND INFORMATION
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have promised
telephone connectivity to 4,899 villages in
the State of Orissa by 2007 under the
Bharat Nirman Programme;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether with the coverage of the
above villages, all the villages in the State
would be provided with Village Public
Telephones; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Blocking of websites
2114. SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have asked the Internet Service Providers
(ISPs) in the country to block certain
websites containing private weblogs;
(b) if so, the details of the order;
(c) whether it is also a fact that in
contravention of Government's order some
ISPs had blocked entire websites, instead
of relevant weblogs;
(d) if so, whether any action has been
taken against the erring ISPs; and
(e) the details of any other action taken
by Government to prevent such blanket
blocking of websites by the ISPs?

487
Verification of prepaid customers for
national security
2115. SHRI RAJEEV CHANDRA-
SEKHAR: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the current discussion on
customer verification of prepaid customers
is driven by national security consideration
or any other;
(b) if so, keeping in view the national
security consideration, in what manner
this proposal would be hundred per cent
fool proof;
(c) whether sampling for security
verification be equivalent to suggest that,
immigration should check cent per cent
visa rather than ten per cent sampling;
and
(d) Government's views on prepaid
verification?
Jamming of websites in Mumbai
2116. SHRI S.S. AHLUWALIA: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have ordered
jamming of several internet websites
following the serial bomb blasts on 11th
July, 2006 in Mumbai;
(b) if so, the details thereof, including
the sites sought to be jammed indicating
the reasons therefor in respect of each
site;
(c) whether the jamming orders based
on finding of any investigations revealing
use of websites by anti-national and
terrorist organizations for subversive/
terrorist activities in the country;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) the effectiveness of jamming as the
sites remain accessible from outside India;
(f) whether any organization has
lodged protest against the order for
jamming their website; and
(g) the details thereof?
Regularization of CICs' services in
North-Eastern States
2117. SHRI INDRAMONI BORA:
Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are going to
utilize the 487 CICs established in North
Eastern States as well as the CIC
personnels after completion of the CIC
projects in February, 2007; and
(b) whether Government would
consider about regularization of their
services?
Inter-connect exchanges
2118. SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
set up National Inter-connect Exchange
to meet the problem of delays in inter-
connection between operators;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?

488
Assessment of telecom equipments
2119. SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether telecom equipment
requirement for 2010 has been assessed;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) in what manner the demand would
be met?
Opening of new post offices in
Rajasthan
2120. DR. GYAN PRAKASH
PILANIA : Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of post offices
functioning in Rajasthan, as on date;
(b) the number of requests pending
with Government for opening of new post
offices in various parts of Rajasthan, till
date;
(c) the procedure adopted for opening
a new post office after receipt of a request
and how much time does it ordinarily
take in its processing;
(d) the number of new post offices
proposed to be opened during the current
year in the State;
(e) the reasons for not opening the
new post offices requested for; and
(f) by when they would be opened?
National Telecom Policy 2006
2121. SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Telecom Regulatory
Authority of India (TRAI) has discussed
the new National Telecom Policy, 2006;
(b) whether he also met cellular
operators both GSM and CDMA and
discussed infrastructure measures to
improve the coverage and quality services
without putting up more and more towers;
(c) if so, whether his Ministry has set
up a joint working group to deal with issues
involved in infrastructure sharing which
enables two or more competing cellular
operators to emit radio signals from same
towers; and
(d) if so, whether the group has already
submitted its report?
Non-functional telephones in Nandla,
Himachal Pradesh
2122. SHRI BHAGWATI SINGH: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have received
numerous complaints regarding non-
working of telephones in Village Nandla in
Shimla district, Himachal Pradesh;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is a fact that the concerned
engineers and officers have not paid due
attention to the problems; and
(d) the action proposed/being taken in
the matter?

489
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Obstruction in the network
†2123. SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARWAL: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Telecom Regulatory
Authority of India (TRAI) has in its report
expressed its concern over the level of
obstructions in the networks of Bharati,
Reliance and other private telecom
companies and public sector company,
Bharat Sanchar Nigam Ltd.;
(b) what has been the level of
obstruction, State-wise in the networks of
private telecom companies and Bharat
Sanchar Nigam Ltd. remained in excess of
the prescribed standards in urban and rural
areas during last three years; and
(c) whether Government have taken any
steps to maintain the level of obstruction
in networks as per the prescribed
standards?
Mobile Number Portability facility
2124. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
to introduce Mobile Number Portability
facility in the mobile telephone segment
shortly in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is a fact that the mobile
phone service providers are not enthusiastic
about the plan as it involves heavy
investment and diversion of funds
earmarked for rural area penetration; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and
Government's reaction thereto?
Package for ITI
2125. SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that ITI Ltd. the
first Public Sector Undertaking set up in
1948 was now in the throes of a battle for
survival;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether Government are considering
to provide a package to ITI to bail out the
PSU from losses; and
(d) if so, the details thereof ?
Faulty telephone exchanges
2126. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will the
Minister of COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
telephone under Palampur-Panchrukhi
Exchange remain out of order for months
together despite complaints made even to
senior officers;
(b) if so, the number of telephones
remained out of order during the last six
months with the reasons therefor;
(c) whether it is a fact that many local
officials of the Department do not pay any
